property_summary: After a successful withdrawAll call by any depositor, the call should succeed (not revert) and release the internal reentrancy lock so that subsequent withdrawAll calls by the same depositor still succeed; the mutant that never releases the lock causes later withdrawAll calls to revert (so the property is violated for some sequences).
change_summary: Remove the lock release after function body in the modifier, leaving the lock permanently set and causing future withdrawAll calls to revert, altering observed behavior.
